name: UK Overseas Territories Fund
summary: Collaborative funder round for environmental work in the UK Overseas Territories, covering practical conservation of land and marine habitats and species, plus capacity building and policy work. Grants run up to three years and can cover core costs.

status.quote: The latest round of the UKOTs Fund is closed and not accepting applications at this time.

opens.quote: The online application portal for the UK Overseas Territories Fund will be open from Monday, 16 March 2026.

deadline.quote: Written applications must be received by 11am (UK time) on Tuesday, 5 May 2026.

applicant_types.quote: We welcome applications from UK charities working in partnership with local Territory-based NGOs and from charities based in the UKOTs.

geography.quote: We want to support transformative and locally-led change in the UKOTs through responsive environmental grantmaking.

access.quote: We will not accept applications that are not submitted via our online application portal.

window.quote: The latest round of the UKOTs Fund is closed and not accepting applications at this time.
